name: qatrack
description: QATrack - DevOps Kanban Board for QA Tools (IIS / Windows Server). Root tooling orchestration.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix src/Frontend ci && dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore KanbanBoard.sln && npm run hooks:install
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config merge.ff false
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run test:e2e
